name: Aokie Receptionist
description: An AI phone receptionist run by OAIY and the Aokie Bluetooth phone bridge: OAIY answers the calls, and FormLogic keeps the front desk, with a live call console and answer/hang-up/speak controls, automatic call, transcript and SMS records, caller lookup, booking requests, call summaries, SMS reply drafts and follow-up tasks via starter FormLogic Flows. Includes 10 forms and 1 app.
